shots.alt: The 3D model dialog: the model as a 3D file at its real size, for Blender or another 3D program, AR or a 3D printer; GLB (.glb) chosen from the list of formats, with a line on what a GLB file holds and opens in; Cancel and Export.
shots.caption: File › Export › 3D model…, with GLB chosen: the list also has glTF, OBJ, STL and 3MF.
